messages:
customer_zeta: hi, after the model update last night some of our embedded assistant replies reverted to old onboarding/marketing lines. same exact prompt sometimes returns outdated copy. example + req id below.

rachel_support: thanks for reporting — can you paste the prompt, the incorrect reply, route/model/rev and any headers? also repro rate?

customer_zeta: prompt: "Explain Pro onboarding benefits."
reply (stale): "Pro still includes legacy quickstart, free setup credit CODEOLD"
route: hosted-us-west-2
model: rwd-infer-3.2
model_rev: rev-2026-03-16
request_id: zeta-req-77
repro: ~30%

rachel_support: tagging @tom_engineer and @amanda_oncall. can you grab response headers and server logs for that req?

tom_engineer: pulling logs. also please include response headers (x-kv-cache, x-cache-prefix, x-model-rev).

customer_zeta: headers: x-kv-cache: hit
x-cache-prefix: onboarding_blurbs_v1
x-model-rev: rev-2026-03-16

amanda_oncall: hit + new rev. sounds like cached value from previous rev. we had a similar pattern in last month's rollout but thought fixed.

tom_engineer: server log snippet for zeta-req-77:
```
[2026-03-17T21:40:02Z] cluster=hosted-us-west-2 req=zeta-req-77 key_hash=0xa1b2 prefix=onboarding_blurbs_v1 cache_hit=true value_rev=rev-2026-03-02
```

tom_engineer: confirmed: cache entry was populated under rev-2026-03-02; incoming request declared rev-2026-03-16. cache key derivation did not include model_rev so same key reused across revisions. returned stale completion.

amanda_oncall: mitigation options: flush prefix in cluster, disable KV reads for route temporarily, or force rev-check guard (treat mismatch as miss).

rachel_support: customer impact is visible. please advise immediate action.

tom_engineer: issuing admin flush now.

ops-bot: POST /admin/kv/flush?cluster=hosted-us-west-2&prefix=onboarding_blurbs_v1 initiated by tom_engineer  job id d5c2

ops-bot: job d5c2 completed  18 keys removed

customer_zeta: retested 30s after flush — responses now match current copy. looks resolved for now. thanks.

tom_engineer: root cause: KV cache key omitted model revision. rollout to rev-2026-03-16 left older completions available under same keyspace.

amanda_oncall: short-term server-side guard: if cached_value.rev != request.x-model-rev then treat as miss and regenerate. i'll push as a config toggle to canary immediately.

tom_engineer: long-term fixes: include model_id+model_rev in key derivation (PR in review), add rollout hook to auto-invalidate prefixes that reference model artifacts, add e2e tests that simulate rev rollouts and assert zero cross-rev hits, and add an admin endpoint to list prefixes with last-populated-rev metadata.

rachel_support: can you provide ETA on the guard + full key-change PR? customers will want assurance.

tom_engineer: guard -> config toggle to canary within 45 minutes. PR for key-change targeting next patch release (2 business days) but we'll try to expedite if more reports come in.

amanda_oncall: adding a console alert rule: trigger when cache_hit && cached_rev != request_rev so on-call sees regression signals earlier.

rachel_support: thanks all — marking this thread resolved for reporter. @customer_zeta please re-open if you see it again.

customer_zeta: will do, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
